contract.explicit_requirement: milvus_behavioral_insert_query_consistency_001 - After insert, query should return inserted entities within bounded consistency. By symmetry, after delete, search should exclude deleted entities within bounded consistency.

physical.objective_constraint: Deleted entities must not appear in search results after delete operation acknowledges removal (deleteCount > 0)

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED, verdict_B=CONFIRMED, verdict_C=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (all three perspectives agree: this is a true bug)

verdicts.rationale: Raw evidence clearly shows delete operation succeeds (deleteCount=5) but subsequent search still returns all 10 original entities including the 5 deleted ones. This violates bounded consistency expectations and represents a data visibility bug where deleted entities remain visible in search results. The defect persists across collection drop/recreate cycles (shown in both REQ 1-9 and REQ 11-18 sequences), ruling out transient state issues. All three perspectives (contract violation, physical constraint, behavioral gracefulness) confirm this is a genuine bug.
